title: 布隆·魄罗小毯子
description: 大胡子布隆穿保暖上衣，低头替魄罗掖好小毯子，巨大盾牌静立身后。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Braum is a very broad adult Freljordian man with a bald head, huge curled brown mustache, kind eyes, and an enormous muscular build. Retain the iconic moustache and friendly face, adding a fully covering warm blue tunic beneath his fur-edged outerwear, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. His gigantic carved door-like shield stands securely against a stout support behind him.
art_direction.scene: He kneels on one knee beside a little basket and tucks a soft checked blanket around a sleepy round poro. His oversized gloved finger touches only the blanket corner, leaving the animal comfortable. A cabin window and two snow mounds suggest a cozy winter afternoon, and the enormous shield stays still in the background.
art_direction.palette: sky blue, warm brown, snow ivory, muted red
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
